baseline_models.focus_anchor: The imperative at word 3, the favor at word 4, and the repeated divine/deity root at words 5, 11, and 17.
baseline_models.mechanism: Remembering first restores a received good to attention and can then put it into speech; the repeated deity frame directs that recovered good toward corrected attribution rather than private sentiment alone.

activation_trace.role: Inward recovery after absence supplies the first operation, making the imperative a deliberate re-presencing of what had receded.
Voicing and naming supply a coexisting public operation, so remembrance need not remain silent.
Bestowed good and favorable condition provide the content that is recovered and named.
The object of worship supplies the endpoint of attribution across the verse's repeated divine terms.

changed_reading.before: A general instruction to feel grateful for divine blessings.
changed_reading.after: A two-stage discipline restores concrete benefaction to mind and speech so that its giver is named correctly.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The creator at word 9, the exclusion at word 10, the providing verb at word 12, and the final turning at word 21.
baseline_models.mechanism: Creation can be heard as prior measuring as well as origination, while provision is an apportioned share. Their adjacency makes one source both specify and distribute the conditions of life; the exclusion blocks substitution and the ending diagnoses displaced attribution.

activation_trace.role: Prior measuring supplies specification and proportion as part of what the creator does.
Origination supplies the productive side of the same source rather than measurement alone.
An assigned gift or share turns provision into distribution rather than undirected abundance.
Otherness, exception, and exclusion remove any substitute source from the proposed allocation system.
Being turned away supplies the failure mode: the share is experienced while its source is misoriented.

changed_reading.before: God creates and then supplies food, unlike any rival deity.
changed_reading.after: The verse joins specification, origination, and apportionment into one source-system, making rival attribution a substitution error.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence 'provides you from the sky and the earth' at words 12, 14, and 15.
baseline_models.mechanism: The rain sense of provision, the overhanging sky, and fertile ground form a vertical transfer: what comes from above enables what emerges below. Sky and earth are therefore linked stages rather than merely two independent storehouses.

activation_trace.role: Rain counted as provision supplies the moving material between the two named domains.
What is above and overshadows supplies cloud, rain, and the upper stage of the transfer.
Soft, productive ground supplies the receptive lower stage where provision becomes growth.
Received good makes the whole transfer, not only its edible endpoint, available as favor.

changed_reading.before: Provision is supplied from two locations, heaven and earth.
changed_reading.after: Provision is a coupled sky-to-ground process in which descent and terrestrial fertility jointly become the remembered favor.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The movement from 'other' at word 10 through the interrogative at word 20 to the passive turning at word 21.
baseline_models.mechanism: After excluding an alternate creator-provider, the verse asks about direction, manner, or state and then names a turning away. The close is therefore an audit of reorientation and agency, not merely a rhetorical restatement of monotheism.

activation_trace.role: Replacement and altered form supply the possibility that attribution has been exchanged for another configuration.
Interrogation across direction, condition, manner, or time opens several dimensions of the diagnostic question.
Reversal from a proper direction supplies the decisive motion that the question asks the hearer to account for.
Falsehood diverted from truth keeps a narrative form of the same reorientation live alongside spatial turning.

changed_reading.before: The final question simply means that denial is irrational.
changed_reading.after: The final question investigates by what route, in what condition, and under whose pressure experienced provision becomes falsely attributed.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding open/hold pair turns provision into controlled transmission. Mercy passes through an opened access; when held, no secondary agent can restart its dispatch. The provider question thus concerns authority over the channel as well as ownership of its contents.

activation_trace.role: Rain as provision gives the focus a flow whose access can be opened or stopped.
An obstruction giving way supplies the inlet through which the beneficial flow becomes available.
Tender mercy supplies the beneficial substance or effect released through the inlet.
Holding and confinement supply the valve-like opposite of opening in both halves of the construction.
Dispatch and release supply renewed movement, which the construction denies to every independent agent.

structural_cues: The ayah immediately before the focus is a mirrored open/hold and hold/send construction, followed directly by the creator-provider question.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies opening, mercy, confinement, and dispatch; I infer that this control logic governs the focus's sky-earth provision. A live alternative is that 35:2 describes mercy generally without specifying a material channel.

changed_reading.before: The verse identifies the owner of provision.
changed_reading.after: The verse identifies the only agent able to open, stop, and restart the channels by which provision reaches its recipients.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later cues supply a mechanism for the passive turning: a polished surface makes a harmful act appear good, perception ratifies the appearance, and guidance is lost. Repeated deceptive promises show that the rerouting can be socially reinforced rather than only internally generated.

activation_trace.role: Turning away supplies the focus failure whose intermediate mechanism the later sequence makes visible.
A gleaming but unstable lure supplies deceptive surface value that can pull attribution off course.
Applied beautification supplies the operation that changes how the act presents itself without changing its quality.
Seeing by eye or insight supplies the point where presentation becomes an accepted reading.
Apparent goodness supplies the false positive produced by the beautification-perception sequence.
Loss of the intended way supplies the completed reorientation rather than a mere intellectual mistake.
The repeated lure now passes between people, supplying a social feedback loop for the same distortion.

structural_cues: The warning against deception at 35:5 is followed by beautified wrongdoing seen as good at 35:8, and mutual deceptive promising returns at 35:40.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lure, cosmetic improvement, seeing, apparent goodness, and loss of direction; I supply the causal arrow from surface alteration through perception to misattribution. A live alternative is that divine misleading and human beautification are parallel descriptions rather than one pipeline.

changed_reading.before: People are inexplicably turned away despite obvious provision.
changed_reading.after: People can be turned through an inspectable perception loop in which attractive presentation and social promises overwrite the source evidence in front of them.

context_deltas.mechanism: Wind is dispatched, cloud is stirred, the mass is driven, and dead ground is made living. This explicit transport chain verifies the focus's sky-ground cycle and adds a temporal result: provision is a coordinated transition from latent water to revived habitat and finally a model of rising again.

activation_trace.role: Rain counted as provision supplies the focus claim that the later transport sequence unfolds.
Moving air supplies the first carrier in the transport chain.
Agitation out of a prior position supplies cloud formation or mobilization rather than static weather.
A drawn-along cloud mass supplies the water-bearing object being transported.
Directed driving supplies the arrow from atmospheric movement toward a particular receiving land.
Earth becoming alive through rain and growth supplies the observable outcome of provision.
Dried vegetation reopened by rain supplies an ecological bridge from revival to the verse's final rising image.
Life after death supplies the eschatological extension of the same material sequence.

structural_cues: A chain of sequential verbs moves from sent wind to stirred cloud to driven mass to a dead country and revived earth, then explicitly compares that event with rising.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies every transport stage and the revival result; I infer that this sequence concretely instantiates the focus's provision from sky and earth. A live alternative is that its primary function is the analogy of resurrection, with provision only secondary.

changed_reading.before: Sky and earth are broad evidence that God provides.
changed_reading.after: Sky and earth are coupled by a directed logistics chain whose delivered water converts dead capacity into life and foreshadows renewed life.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two remote branches of the focus's final root picture winds changing course and land deprived of rain. The later rain scene reverses both images: wind is intentionally driven toward lifeless land and the land revives. On this reading, false attribution behaves like a diverted current that prevents provision from arriving at its proper cognitive destination.

activation_trace.role: Winds varying from their expected directions supply a material analogue for being turned off course.
Ground from which rain has been averted supplies the deprivation produced by failed arrival.
Actual wind supplies the later scene that can correct the focus root's divergent-wind image.
Purposeful driving supplies corrected direction toward the place of need.
Land without living force supplies the state associated with failed rain arrival.
Rain-grown life supplies the reversal achieved when the current reaches its proper endpoint.

structural_cues: The focus closes with turning, while 35:9 later binds wind direction, delivery, dead land, and revival in one material chain.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies divergent-wind and rain-deprived-land senses for the focus root plus a later directed rain chain; I supply the analogy between material diversion and cognitive attribution. The live alternative is that these are lexical side branches with no discourse-level activation.

changed_reading.before: The final verb denotes cognitive or verbal departure from truth.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the final verb also pictures misattribution as weather diverted from receptive ground, leaving recognition barren until direction is corrected.

context_deltas.mechanism: The remembered gift moves outward as good speech, action, gratitude, and spending from what was apportioned; these responses are pictured as rising and as a transaction followed by increase. Remembrance therefore becomes a return circuit that keeps provision socially and verbally in motion.

activation_trace.role: Spoken mention supplies an outward form for the focus command.
Upward movement supplies the return direction of good speech.
Meaningful speech connecting speakers supplies a communicative realization of remembrance.
Raising supplies the linkage by which action participates in the upward response.
Recognition of a gift and its giver supplies the explicit responsive posture after material provision.
Money leaving its holder supplies material circulation rather than mere possession.
The apportioned gift explicitly returns as the source from which spending occurs.
Growth and addition supply the circuit's non-depleting outcome.
Unowed generosity supplies the excess returned beyond strict equivalence.

structural_cues: The focus root for provision recurs at 35:29 inside recitation, prayer, spending, and unperishing trade, immediately followed by completion and increase at 35:30.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ascent, speech, action, gratitude, spending from provision, and increase; I connect them as a return circuit. A live alternative is that these are adjacent but independent reward images rather than one mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Remembering favor is primarily inward recollection and verbal acknowledgment.
changed_reading.after: Remembering favor can become a circuit of naming, action, gratitude, and redistribution that returns the received share without treating it as exhausted.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later material catalog expands favor beyond an abstract benefit: edible shares come from contrasting waters, rain becomes fruits with divergent paths of appearance, and the same focus root reappears in livestock. Provision is heterogeneous, embodied abundance rather than a single uniform commodity.

activation_trace.role: Bestowed good supplies the broad focus category that the later catalog fills with matter and life.
An edible share supplies a direct bodily form of provision from otherwise contrasting waters.
Mature fruit supplies the terrestrial conversion of descended water into food.
Taking different paths supplies divergence within a common provisioning process.
Visible coloration supplies inspectable variation in fruit and terrain.
Livestock supplies a concrete living member of the same root inventory as the focus's favor.

structural_cues: The sequence moves from two unequal waters that both yield goods, to rain-grown fruits and colored mountains, then to varied people, animals, and livestock.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the material catalog and the later recurrence of the focus root in livestock; I infer a retroactive thickening of favor into diverse edible, wearable, and living goods. A live alternative keeps the livestock word lexically separate from the focus's abstract benefaction.

changed_reading.before: Favor is a general category exemplified by sustenance.
changed_reading.after: Favor is materially plural: food, fruit, terrain, color, and livestock are differentiated outputs of one sky-earth provision system.

context_deltas.mechanism: Creation unfolds through bearing, birth, measured lifespan, replacement, and the active holding of heaven and earth against displacement. The focus's creator is therefore not only an initiator but the continuous support of the temporal and cosmic conditions within which provision remains possible.

activation_trace.role: Measurement supplies proportion and temporal specification within creation.
Origination supplies the starting act that later stages extend rather than replace.
Hidden bearing and fruiting supply development within a protected interior stage.
Release through birth supplies transition from hidden formation into the world.
Life extended through time supplies a measured duration after emergence.
Part-by-part decrease supplies temporal contraction alongside extension.
A newly originated creation supplies replacement capacity beyond the present population.
Newness after a break supplies discontinuity as another mode of continued creative power.
Active holding supplies ongoing cosmic support rather than a completed past act.
Departure from place or state supplies the instability that continuous holding prevents.

structural_cues: The surah expands origin into a life-cycle of dust, drop, pairing, pregnancy, birth, and lifespan, then adds replacement and the holding of heaven and earth.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies lifecycle stages, replacement, and cosmic holding; I infer that these are continuous dimensions of the focus's creator-provider identity. A live alternative distinguishes creation as origin from later sustaining acts more sharply.

changed_reading.before: Creator names the one who began existence before providing for it.
changed_reading.after: Creator names the one who measures development, permits emergence and replacement, and continuously holds the world in which provision can arrive.

context_deltas.mechanism: All people depend on the provider for their received share, yet later burden imagery refuses interpersonal transfer of responsibility. The relation is asymmetrical dependence without a human substitute who can either originate provision or absorb another person's moral load.

activation_trace.role: An apportioned benefit supplies what each recipient cannot self-originate.
Need and lack of resources supply the universal recipient-side condition.
Self-sufficing adequacy supplies the source-side condition that does not depend on the recipients.
A heavy carried load supplies the moral burden that remains attached to its bearer.
Loading with weight supplies the attempted transfer situation.
Bearing an entrusted or culpable load supplies the action that even a close relation cannot perform for another.

structural_cues: The second direct address to people at 35:15 declares collective need, while 35:18 immediately individualizes loads and self-purification.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies universal need, source sufficiency, and nontransferable loads; I infer that the focus's provider monopoly and later accountability share an anti-substitution logic. A live alternative treats material dependence and moral burden as separate domains.

changed_reading.before: Humans are recipients who should acknowledge the one provider.
changed_reading.after: Humans share radical dependence on one provider while remaining individually non-substitutable as bearers of their response to that provision.

context_deltas.mechanism: Cosmic stability and delayed seizure create an interval in which misattribution can look consequence-free. Yet harmful plotting encloses its own makers, historical outcomes repeat, and every delay has a term. The focus question gains a temporal edge: present provision and stability must not be mistaken for validation of the direction one has taken.

activation_trace.role: The interrogative supplies the ordinary question about how or from where reorientation occurs.
Slowness and waiting supply an exploratory temporal resonance within that question.
Turning away supplies the state that reprieve can allow to persist for a time.
Forbearance and restraint supply non-immediate response despite the maintained order.
Harm descending and enclosing supplies eventual self-return of the deceptive scheme.
A repeatedly traveled pattern supplies temporal regularity beneath apparent delay.
The end-state of a process supplies historical visibility of where a direction leads.
Deferral to a later time supplies the interval in which false inference can persist.
A fixed temporal limit supplies the endpoint that prevents reprieve from becoming indefinite approval.

structural_cues: The closing sequence moves from a held cosmos and forbearance, through increased aversion and self-enclosing plots, to historical outcomes and a delayed but fixed term.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies stability, restraint, enclosing consequence, repeated pattern, outcome, delay, and term; I infer that delay helps explain how turning can persist amid provision. A live alternative keeps the focus interrogative purely directional and leaves the temporal account to the closing ayat alone.

changed_reading.before: The question asks how people can turn away in the face of present evidence.
changed_reading.after: The question also asks how a period of stable provision and delayed consequence can be misread as approval, allowing the wrong direction to harden before its term.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses a non-dominant mapped target of the focus sky root, not the ordinary sky sense. It remains anchored by the supplied split mapping and by the later descent-water-color sequence; downstream prose should present it only as a material resonance in which first rain writes visible marks on earth, never as a replacement translation of the sky word.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The sky at word 14 as a split-root activation alongside provision and earth.

activation_trace.role: First rain leaving vegetative signs on ground supplies an inscription-like relation between the focus's upper and lower domains.
Caused descent supplies the movement by which the marking medium arrives.
Water delivered by pouring or irrigation supplies the material that makes terrestrial signs emerge.
Visible coloration supplies the legible differentiation left by the provision process.

changed_reading.before: The sky is the upper source-region of provision.
changed_reading.after: As a contained split-root resonance, the sky becomes the origin of rain that inscribes provision as visible difference across the earth.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is surprising because the ordinary collective address is activated through its mapped perception-and-familiarity inventory. It remains anchored to the exact focus root and is sharpened by later sight/hearing contrasts; downstream prose should call it a resonance of human perceptual capacity, not an etymological redefinition of 'people'.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The addressed people at word 2 joined to the remembering imperative at word 3.

activation_trace.role: Noticing through sight, sensation, or hearing supplies a latent human capacity that the address can summon.
Familiar presence that removes estrangement supplies the relational result of recovered perception.
Restoring what was absent supplies the operation by which dormant noticing becomes active recognition.
Actual seeing supplies one side of the later contrast between available and unavailable reception.
Causing another to hear supplies the restoration of reception beyond mere sound exposure.

changed_reading.before: The opening address merely identifies the universal audience.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the address also summons humans as beings capable of having provision made perceptible and familiar again through remembrance.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This cross-domain reading is surprising because it carries the softness branch of favor through opening, grief, toil, and fatigue. It remains anchored to the focus noun and a coherent relief sequence; downstream prose should describe favor as including lowered resistance and restored ease, not reduce all blessing to comfort or deny demanding forms of good.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The favor at word 4, heard through its softness and ease branch.

activation_trace.role: Softness, ease, and well-being supply a qualitative measure of favor rather than a count of goods.
Relief of a nonphysical constriction supplies the transition from resistance to ease.
Inner roughness produced by grief supplies one friction that is later removed.
Toil that wears a person down supplies bodily resistance absent from the final dwelling.
Weakness and fatigue supply the depleted state that completed favor no longer permits.

changed_reading.before: Favor consists chiefly in items or conditions granted to recipients.
changed_reading.after: Favor can also be felt as the opening and softening of life: grief, resistance, toil, and depletion are progressively relieved.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it activates the focus creator root through a rock hollow or newly cut well that retains rainwater. It remains anchored to the supplied focus inventory and the explicit sky-rain-earth chain; downstream prose should treat it as an analogy that creation includes making receptive capacities, never as the lexical meaning of 'creator' in the verse.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The creator at word 9 adjacent to rain-provision at word 12 and the sky-earth pair.

activation_trace.role: A formed depression or well that retains rain supplies the image of created receptivity, not production alone.
Rain as provision supplies what the receptive form is made capable of holding.
The transported cloud supplies the mobile store approaching a receiving site.
Rain-enabled terrestrial life supplies the purpose of receiving and retaining the delivered water.
Delivered water supplies the material whose reception turns formed capacity into fruitfulness.

changed_reading.before: Creation is productive origination, followed by externally delivered provision.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material analogy, creation also forms capacities that can catch and retain provision, so receiving is itself part of created design.

strongest_changes: The preceding open/hold construction recast provision as exclusive control over access and dispatch, not ownership alone.
The deception and beautified-perception sequence supplied a causal account of how experienced provision can be falsely attributed.
The wind-cloud-driving-revival chain converted sky and earth into a directed material process and linked daily provision with renewed life.
Later speech, action, gratitude, spending, and increase made remembrance an enacted return circuit.
Lifecycle measurement, replacement, and cosmic holding expanded creator from past originator to continuous support.
summary.what_was_special: The most distinctive activations came from branch intersections rather than topic matching: weather senses of the final turning root, the livestock recurrence of the favor root, and split mappings that let sky resonate as rain-marking and people as recoverable perceivers. These readings remain separate because each changes a different mechanism.
remaining_uncertainties: Whether the weather branches of the final turning root are discourse activations or only useful material analogies.
Whether the later livestock occurrence should retroactively concretize the focus's favor or remain a separate lexical member.
How much temporal delay should be heard in the focus interrogative rather than supplied only by the closing ayat.
Whether ascent, spending, gratitude, and increase form one return circuit or several adjacent response images.
How strongly the non-dominant split mappings should shape prose without obscuring the ordinary syntax.
